allow_plaintext_auth.description: Allow plain-text authentication over unencrypted connections. Not recommended without TLS.

allow_digest_md5.description: Enable DIGEST-MD5 authentication mechanism (requires extra support).

listeners.description: List of network interfaces and ports to listen on.

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind to (use * for all).

port.description: Port number (110 for plain POP3, 995 for POP3S).

maildir_path.description: Default directory path (relative to home dir) for user mailboxes (e.g., 'Maildir').

enable_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for secure connections (POP3S or STARTTLS).

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format).

tls_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key (PEM format). If omitted, assumed same as certificate file.

tls_min_version.description: Minimum allowed TLS version. Recommended: 'tls1.2' or 'tls1.3'.

tls_cipher_list.description: Custom cipher list for TLS (e.g., 'ECDHE+AESGCM:ECDHE+CHACHA20'). Leave empty for system defaults.

max_connections_per_ip.description: Maximum number of POP3 connections allowed per client IP.

max_total_connections.description: Maximum total number of simultaneous connections.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before an idle connection is closed.

auth_timeout.description: Seconds allowed for authentication before connection is dropped.

log_to_file.description: Log to a file instead of syslog.

log_file.description: Path to the POP3 daemon log file (used only if log_to_file=true).
